name: IL Tsunawoharu Championship
notes: Isamu League's own top championship, unveiled at a press conference on 31 January 2010. The fed's own promoter announced on Lesson 2 (23 March 2010) that the first champion would be crowned by a one-night tournament, open to the whole roster, at the fed's planned debut pay-per-view, National Threat I, in June 2010.
epitaph: A championship belt unveiled with fanfare and never contested: Isamu League's own planned coronation tournament never got a card, and no document in the held record ever names a Tsunawoharu Champion.
